children: U.S. spirits maker's fiscal Q1 revenue fell 1%, a slight miss versus analyst expectations
Diluted EPS for fiscal Q1 rose 6% to $0.38
Company cites end of Korbel relationship and tequila declines as key revenue drivers
Company expects fiscal 2027 organic net sales to be approximately flat
Company sees fiscal 2027 organic operating income declining 3% to 5%
Brown-Forman anticipates continued macroeconomic and geopolitical pressures to weigh on developed markets
KORBEL RELATIONSHIP END - Co said net sales declines were primarily driven by the end of the Korbel relationship
TEQUILA WEAKNESS - Co said tequila portfolio net sales fell 12% due to lower volumes in the U.S. and lower net pricing in Mexico
READY-TO-DRINK GROWTH - Co said growth in Ready-to-Drink portfolio, led by New Mix, helped offset declines elsewhere
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 13 "hold" and 4 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the distillers & wineries peer group is "hold"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Brown-Forman Corporation is $28.00, about 6.2% above its September 1 closing price of $26.36
The stock recently traded at 16 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 15 three months ago
